MY BRIDGE WORKSHOP

My Bridge Test Results

Record what your flat and folded bridges actually hold.

Look, then try.

Add one identical block at a time at the centre. Count only blocks held before noticeable bending or slipping; record zero if the first block causes that. Use the same stopping rule for both designs. Record slipping separately from bending. If you run out of blocks, write “held all available blocks”; you have not found the limit.

Start drawing and writing below

Open the worksheet to print or save

Work with a grown-up on a low surface. Use large lightweight blocks and stable, low supports. Keep fingers clear if the bridge slips. Never stand on the model bridge.

Use a finger, stylus or mouse in each drawing box. Type below it, or ask a grown-up to write your words. Your work stays in this tab. Save before refreshing or leaving.

ACTIVITY 3

Compare

Draw or describe the difference you noticed.

Your ideas belong here. There is no score.

What are we learning?

A result includes both a count and an observation. Fair comparisons use the same method and stopping rule.
